events.description: Called with the ids now expanded each time a row opens or closes.
events.name: onExpandedChange

events.description: Called with a row's id when it is activated (pressed, or Enter on web).
events.name: onAction

events.description:
Loads the children of a row marked `hasChildren` the first time it is expanded. A spinner row shows while the
promise is pending and the tree keeps the rows it resolves to; a rejection closes the row so it can be tried again.
events.name: onLoadChildren

events.description:
Called when rows are dragged (or moved from the keyboard) to a new place: before or after a row, or inside it.
Given, rows can be dragged on web; the tree does not move them itself, so update `items` (`moveTreeNodes` does
it). Native has no dragging and ignores it.
events.name: onMove

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

props.description: The accessible name of the tree, for example "Chart of accounts".
props.name: label

props.description: The ids of the expanded rows, for a controlled tree; pair it with `onExpandedChange`.
props.name: expandedKeys

props.description: The ids expanded at the start, for an uncontrolled tree.
props.name: defaultExpandedKeys

props.description:
True with `selectionMode="multiple"`: checking a row checks every row under it, a row is checked once all its
rows are, and a row with only some of its rows checked shows a dash. The selection holds every checked id.
props.name: isSelectionPropagated

props.description: What a press or Space does: nothing, select one item, or toggle several. Defaults to `none`.
props.name: selectionMode

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID
